name: level1-win-efficient
description: Level 1 (Dusty Hollow) won genuinely (#1363): one tight 2x2 blast after clearing the blast zone, selling the rock afterwards, then waiting for operating profit to reach the target. No cash override, no staffed flag, no campaign complete.

steps.description: The level exactly as the UI starts it: no cash override, no staffed flag. It opens with a driller, a blaster, a driver, a drill rig, a debris hauler and a freight warehouse (#1363).
Speed up the waits below.

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:2 cols:2 spacing:3 depth:6 start:15,15

expect.note: 4 holes ordered with the level's own crew and rig.

steps.description: Order a drill grid with the crew and rig the level opens with: nothing was hired or bought.
Cycle 1: the driller lands every ordered hole.
Cycle 1: the blaster loads every charge.
Pin dry weather right before the blast: standing water in the holes (#1350) would weaken the water-sensitive boomite charges.

Wait until no hole holds standing water (#1350): wet holes weaken water-sensitive charges, and natural weather may have wetted them while the crew worked. Costs no ticks when the holes are already dry.
#1362: FIRE then DETONATE once. DETONATE sounds the horn itself and fires automatically as soon as nobody is left in the danger zone -- no separate Sound the Horn, wait, FIRE sequence.
#1362: wait for the automatic fire -- the blast clears the plan (holeCount 0) only once the evacuation finished and the sequence fired.
(#1362: the blast already fired by itself; this step closes its report.)
Let the hauler start clearing the blasted rock before selling it.

Accept an ore sale the store covers in full.
